en: The image is an old, monochrome postcard showing a historical building with a steep roof and a church-like tower topped with a cross. Bare trees surround the structure, and there is an arched gateway in the foreground, leading through a wall. The text on the postcard reads 'Rochlitz.' and 'Partie im Schloss.' There is also a publisher's mark along the side: '5719 Brück & Sohn, Meissen 1905.'
